description.value: Comfort Suites Kelowna is an 83-suite all-suite hotel on Highway 97 North, conveniently situated about 10 minutes from Kelowna Airport and close to downtown, beaches, and the Okanagan wine country. The property features an indoor pool with a 40-foot waterslide, a 24-hour fitness centre, and a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring. It is pet-friendly and offers a range of suite types including wheelchair-accessible and family configurations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The hotel's own website (facilities and suite amenity pages) is the primary evidence source and is fully accessible. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the facilities page is detailed and exhaustive, so absence here is meaningful (but still scored null, not false, per rules). Confirmed amenities from the website: coin-operated laundry, ice/vending machines, free fibre optic internet, and in-suite charging stations. OSM phone (+1-250-861-1110) matches the website local number (250-861-1110); address also matches exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational hotel with an active website and confirmed open status; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation in Kelowna.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also lists a toll-free booking number (1-800-424-6423) and a second toll-free (1-888-348-2186) not present in OSM, but the local number matches exactly.
